articles.title: Etah Education Dept WhatsApp Groups Rocked by Obscene Content Scandal!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Etah, UP – The Education Department has once again landed in controversy after obscene pictures and porn site links were allegedly shared in two official WhatsApp groups.

body.html:
Etah, UP – The Education Department has once again landed in controversy after obscene pictures and porn site links were allegedly shared in two official WhatsApp groups. In the “Mission Prerna” group, a teacher is accused of sending obscene photos, while in the Nagar Block Education Officer’s group, both obscene images and porn links were circulated.

Female teachers, along with the BSA and ABSA, are members of these groups, causing uproar after the incident. BSA Dinesh Kumar has ordered strict action against the accused teacher. The controversy follows a similar case that recently emerged in Maharajganj, UP.

articles.title: Reel Craze Turns Deadly on Delhi–Dehradun Expressway: 2 Youths Killed in Stunt Collision
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Loni, Ghaziabad – On the unopened Delhi–Dehradun Expressway, a dangerous stunt claimed two lives and left another critically injured. Two bikers, performing stunts in opposite directions, collided head-on at high speed.

body.html:
Loni, Ghaziabad – On the unopened Delhi–Dehradun Expressway, a dangerous stunt claimed two lives and left another critically injured. Two bikers, performing stunts in opposite directions, collided head-on at high speed. Rohit Sharma died on the spot, while Subodh succumbed to injuries in hospital. Sanjay Sharma remains in critical condition.

The expressway, still closed to public traffic, has reportedly become a hotspot for stunt videos and reel-making. A passerby captured the horrific crash on video, now viral, showing a bike soaring into the air before both riders hit the ground.

articles.title: Chandigarh’s Bizarre Theft: Thieves Risk It All for… Dustbins!
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Chandigarh – In a peculiar case of theft, a resident reported on social media platform X that two masked men stole not cash or jewellery, but two dustbins kept outside his house.

body.html:
Chandigarh – In a peculiar case of theft, a resident reported on social media platform X that two masked men stole not cash or jewellery, but two dustbins kept outside his house. The incident, captured on CCTV on 14 August around 4 PM, shows the duo arriving on a scooter, one closing the gate before swiftly picking up the dustbins and fleeing.

The 37-second footage reveals no visible number plate or clear identity. Responding to the viral post, Chandigarh Police asked the complainant to approach the local police station for further action. The unusual theft has left netizens baffled.

articles.title: Indore Heist in 4 Minutes: Masked Burglars Loot Retired Judge’s House as Family Sleeps
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Indore, Madhya Pradesh – A shocking CCTV video has emerged showing masked burglars breaking into the home of retired Justice Ramesh Garg in Pragati Park Colony during the early hours of 12 August.

body.html:
Indore, Madhya Pradesh – A shocking CCTV video has emerged showing masked burglars breaking into the home of retired Justice Ramesh Garg in Pragati Park Colony during the early hours of 12 August. The intruders, suspected to be from the notorious Baag Tanda gang, completed the theft in just over four minutes.

Cutting through an iron grill, they entered the room of the judge’s son where the family was sleeping, broke open a cupboard, and escaped with over ₹5 lakh in cash, along with gold and silver jewellery. Despite an alarm going off, neither the family nor the security guard woke up.

Police said the burglars wore gloves to avoid leaving fingerprints. Forensic teams, sniffer dogs, and multiple police units are working to identify and apprehend the culprits, who were also linked to four other thefts and an attempted burglary in Indore the same night.

articles.title: Kishtwar Cloudburst: Massive Army-Led Relief Mission in Full Swing
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Kishtwar, J&K – Relief operations are in full swing in Chisoti village following the recent cloudburst.

body.html:
Kishtwar, J&K – Relief operations are in full swing in Chisoti village following the recent cloudburst. Over five columns of 60 personnel each from the Indian Army, along with medical detachments, are on the ground, working round the clock with the Jammu & Kashmir Police (#JKP), State Disaster Response Force (#SDRF) and other civilian agencies.

Teams are engaged in rescuing stranded individuals, providing medical aid, and assisting affected families. The search for missing persons continues, with relief materials and support reaching impacted areas without pause.
